- **Story:** #34
- **Layer:** config
- **Size:** M (~250 changed lines, 10 files, excluding tests and package-lock.json)
- **Serial:** yes (dependency change, CI/build, shared config)
- **Depends on:** none

## Goal
Create the empty TodoNow Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Node.js 22) project with ESLint + Prettier, Vitest + Testing Library, Playwright (mobile profiles) and a GitHub Actions CI workflow running `npm run lint`, `npm test` and the e2e suite.

## Out of scope
- Internationalisation with next-intl (next task of this story).
- Prisma, PostgreSQL and the CI database service (task "Add Prisma with Postgres and User model migration", story #35).
- PWA / Serwist setup (story S-15, later).
- Any product screen: the home page is a placeholder only.

## Files (expected)
- `package.json` (new, ~45 lines: scripts `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint`, `test`, `test:e2e`, `format`; `engines.node` >= 22; Prettier config in the `prettier` key)
- `package-lock.json` (new, generated)
- `tsconfig.json` (new, ~25 lines, strict, `@/*` -> `src/*`)
- `next.config.ts` (new, ~10 lines)
- `eslint.config.mjs` (new, ~20 lines, next/core-web-vitals + typescript + prettier)
- `vitest.config.ts` (new, ~20 lines, jsdom, include only `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}`)
- `playwright.config.ts` (new, ~35 lines, projects "Pixel 7" and "iPhone 14", testDir `e2e`, testMatch `**/*.test.ts`, webServer `npm run build && npm run start` on `PORT`)
- `src/app/layout.tsx` (new, ~20 lines)
- `src/app/page.tsx` (new, ~10 lines, placeholder "TodoNow")
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (new, ~50 lines: jobs lint, test, e2e on push to main and pull_request)
- `.gitignore` (edit/new, ~15 lines: node_modules, .next, coverage, test-results, playwright-report, .env, .worktrees/)
- `src/app/page.test.tsx` (new test)
- `e2e/smoke.test.ts` (new test)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npx playwright test` succeed locally on Node.js 22
- [ ] Tests: a Vitest + Testing Library unit test renders the home page and asserts the "TodoNow" text; a Playwright smoke test opens `/` on both mobile profiles and asserts the page title
- [ ] CI workflow runs lint, unit tests and e2e (with `npx playwright install --with-deps`) on every pull request and is green on the PR
- [ ] Vitest does not pick up files under `e2e/`, and Playwright does not pick up files under `src/`
- [ ] Lint and tests green; independently mergeable

## Acceptance criteria covered
- none (enabler for every task of stories #34, #35, #36)

## Why not smaller
A new repository needs the app, its lint, both test runners and CI together: CI cannot be green without a runnable app and test runners, and a test runner without CI leaves the main quality gate missing. Splitting would leave a PR that cannot prove itself.

## Notes
- Unit tests are named `*.test.ts(x)` next to the code under `src/`; e2e tests are `e2e/*.test.ts`. This naming keeps tests out of the PR size count (`**/*.test.*`).
- The Playwright web server must honour `PORT` (each developer slot uses `port_base + slot`, base 4100) and use `reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI`.
- Use `create-next-app` output as a starting point but remove sample assets and CSS you do not need; keep the diff small.
- Use `npm` (lockfile `package-lock.json`); `commands.install` is `npm ci`.

## Goal
Show the interface in Vietnamese or English chosen from the browser language (Vietnamese if the language is Vietnamese, English if it is English, Vietnamese otherwise), using next-intl without locale prefixes in the URL and without any language setting.

## Out of scope
- The privacy notice text and page (next task, "Add privacy notice page in Vietnamese and English").
- Translating any other screen; each screen task adds its own keys.
- Story S-14 (the rest of the interface language behaviour) beyond this shared mechanism.

## Files (expected)
- `package.json` (edit, ~2 lines: add `next-intl`)
- `package-lock.json` (edit, generated)
- `next.config.ts` (edit, ~5 lines: next-intl plugin)
- `src/i18n/request.ts` (new, ~45 lines: exported pure `resolveLocale(acceptLanguage: string | null): "vi" | "en"` and `getRequestConfig` that reads the `accept-language` request header)
- `src/app/layout.tsx` (edit, ~15 lines: `<html lang={locale}>` and `NextIntlClientProvider`)
- `messages/vi.json` (new, ~5 lines: `common.appName`)
- `messages/en.json` (new, ~5 lines: `common.appName`)
- `src/i18n/request.test.ts` (new test)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] `resolveLocale` returns `vi` for `vi`, `vi-VN`; `en` for `en`, `en-US`, `en-GB`; `vi` for `fr-FR`, `ja`, an empty or missing header and a malformed header
- [ ] The language is taken from the browser's first (highest-preference) language tag only: `en-US,vi;q=0.9` gives `en`, `vi-VN,en;q=0.8` gives `vi`, `fr-FR,en;q=0.8` gives `vi`
- [ ] The root layout sets `<html lang>` to the resolved locale and provides messages to client components
- [ ] Tests: unit tests for `resolveLocale` covering every case above; existing home page test still passes
- [ ] Lint and tests green; independently mergeable

## Acceptance criteria covered
- #34 AC2 "Notice in Vietnamese" and AC3 "Notice in English": language selection mechanism (the notice itself is in the next task)

## Notes
- Rule source: FR-13 / BR-22 / Q-12 in `docs/requirements/todonow/requirements.md`. There is no stored language preference and no language switch in the app.
- Use next-intl's "without i18n routing" setup (no `[locale]` segment, no locale middleware). Keep `messages/vi.json` and `messages/en.json` as the single message files; later screen tasks add their own top-level namespace (`privacy`, `signup`, `login`, `tasks`).
- Playwright sets the browser language with the `locale` context option, which drives `accept-language`; later e2e tests rely on this.

## Goal
Add a public `/privacy` page that shows the short privacy notice (what personal data TodoNow stores and why) in the visitor's language, with a link back to the sign-up screen.

## Out of scope
- The sign-up screen and its link to this page (next task, "Add sign-up screen shell with privacy notice link").
- Agreeing to the notice at sign-up (story #35).
- Any login check: this page is public.

## Files (expected)
- `src/app/privacy/page.tsx` (new, ~40 lines: server component, heading, notice sections, "Back to sign-up" link to `/signup`)
- `messages/vi.json` (edit, ~40 lines: `privacy` namespace, Vietnamese draft text)
- `messages/en.json` (edit, ~40 lines: `privacy` namespace, English draft text)
- `src/app/privacy/page.test.tsx` (new test)
- `e2e/privacy-notice.test.ts` (new test)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] `/privacy` renders without a login and shows the notice title, the data stored and why, and a link to `/signup`
- [ ] The notice content covers: the data stored (email, display name, password stored only in non-readable form, tasks and their sharing, family membership, privacy notice agreement); why it is stored; connections are encrypted; a person sees only their own tasks and tasks shared with them; deleting the account removes personal data; personal data is never shared with or sold to others
- [ ] Vietnamese and English texts say the same thing (same keys in both files, no missing key)
- [ ] Tests: unit test renders the page with the `vi` and `en` messages and asserts the title and the "Back to sign-up" link; a unit test asserts `messages/vi.json` and `messages/en.json` have the same `privacy` keys; Playwright test opens `/privacy` with browser locale `vi-VN`, `fr-FR` (expects Vietnamese) and `en-US` (expects English)
- [ ] Lint and tests green; independently mergeable

## Acceptance criteria covered
- #34 AC2 "Notice in Vietnamese"
- #34 AC3 "Notice in English"
- #34 AC4 "Approved content" (draft text; see Notes)

## Notes
- Content source: FR-23, Q-23 items 1, 2, 5, 6 and Q-31 in `docs/requirements/todonow/requirements.md` and `questions.md`. Write plain, short sentences.
- The team drafts the text; the stakeholder must approve both languages before launch (R-07). Put the text only in the message files so an approved revision is a message-file-only change. The PM tracks the approval; QA verifies AC4 against the approved text.
- Keep the page readable on a phone screen (mobile-first; no desktop layout needed).

## Files (expected)

## Goal
Provide two pure server-side helpers: `checkPasswordRule(password)` implementing the password rule (BR-24) and `hashPassword` / `verifyPassword` using argon2id.

## Out of scope
- Using the helpers in sign-up (task "Add sign-up service creating a user account") or login (story #36).
- The exhaustive accepted/refused case list of story S-29; this task implements the rule as written in BR-24 and covers its main cases.
- Showing the rule on screen (sign-up form task).

## Files (expected)
- `package.json` (edit, ~1 line: add `@node-rs/argon2`)
- `package-lock.json` (edit, generated)
- `src/lib/auth/password-rule.ts` (new, ~35 lines: returns `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, failures: ("tooShort" | "noLowercase" | "noUppercase" | "noDigit" | "noSymbol" | "invalidCharacter")[] }`)
- `src/lib/auth/password-hash.ts` (new, ~25 lines: `hashPassword`, `verifyPassword`, argon2id)
- `src/lib/auth/password-rule.test.ts` (new test)
- `src/lib/auth/password-hash.test.ts` (new test)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Rule: at least 8 characters; at least one lowercase a-z, one uppercase A-Z, one digit 0-9 and one keyboard symbol as defined in A-20 (the 32 printable ASCII symbols: every printable ASCII character that is not a letter, a digit or a space); no other characters (no spaces, no letters with Vietnamese marks such as ă, â, đ, ê, ô, ơ, ư or tone marks, upper or lower case)
- [ ] `hashPassword` returns an argon2id hash (`$argon2id$` prefix) that does not contain the password; `verifyPassword` returns true for the right password and false otherwise
- [ ] Tests: `Abcdef1!` accepted; `Abcde1!` (7 chars) refused `tooShort`; missing lowercase / uppercase / digit / symbol each refused with the matching failure; `Abcdef1! x` refused `invalidCharacter` (space); `Ăbcdef1!` and `Abcdèf1!` refused `invalidCharacter`; each of the 32 A-20 symbols is accepted as the symbol; hash/verify round trip and wrong-password case
- [ ] Lint and tests green; independently mergeable (helpers are not used yet)

- #35 AC5 "Password not stored readable" (hashing)

- Prefer `@node-rs/argon2` (prebuilt binaries, no node-gyp). Never import these files from client components.

## Goal
Add `signUp({ email, password, displayName, agreedToPrivacyNotice })` that creates a `User` with a hashed password and the agreement time, or returns a typed error without creating anything.

## Out of scope
- HTTP handling (task "Add sign-up API endpoint").
- The form and messages shown to the visitor (task "Add sign-up form to the sign-up screen").
- Logging the new user in (story #36).

## Files (expected)
- `src/lib/auth/sign-up.ts` (new, ~90 lines)
- `src/lib/auth/sign-up.test.ts` (new test)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Success returns `{ ok: true, userId }`; the stored email is trimmed and lowercased, `passwordHash` is an argon2id hash, `privacyNoticeAgreedAt` is set
- [ ] Errors return `{ ok: false, error }` with `error` one of `AGREEMENT_REQUIRED`, `EMAIL_TAKEN`, `PASSWORD_RULE` (with the rule failures), `INVALID_INPUT` (empty or malformed email, empty display name after trimming); no user row is created in any error case
- [ ] Check order: input, then agreement, then password rule, then email taken; a concurrent duplicate (Prisma unique violation `P2002`) also maps to `EMAIL_TAKEN`
- [ ] Tests (integration, real test database): successful sign-up and `verifyPassword` works with the stored hash; no agreement creates no user; existing email (also with different case or surrounding spaces) gives `EMAIL_TAKEN` and the user count is unchanged; rule-breaking password gives `PASSWORD_RULE` and no user; the stored row contains no field equal to or containing the plain password
- [ ] Lint and tests green; independently mergeable (not wired to any route yet)

## Acceptance criteria covered
- #35 AC1 "Successful sign-up"
- #35 AC2 "Agreement is required"
- #35 AC3 "Email already used"
- #35 AC4 "Password that breaks the rule is refused"
- #35 AC5 "Password not stored readable"

## Notes
- Reuse `src/lib/db.ts`, `src/lib/auth/password-rule.ts` and `src/lib/auth/password-hash.ts`.
- No display name length rule is stated in the requirements: enforce only "not empty after trimming"; raise anything else with the Team Lead instead of inventing a rule.
- Email format check: a simple `local@domain` shape is enough; do not send any email.

## Goal
Add the server-side login logic: check email and password, create a per-device session with a random token stored only as a hash, and resolve the current user from the session cookie.

## Out of scope
- HTTP endpoint and setting the cookie on a response (task "Add login API endpoint setting the session cookie").
- Redirects and page protection (task "Protect task pages with a login check and add the task list placeholder").
- Log out and "log out on all devices" (stories S-30, S-31).

## Files (expected)
- `src/lib/auth/login.ts` (new, ~35 lines: `authenticate(email, password)` returns the user id or `null`)
- `src/lib/auth/session.ts` (new, ~60 lines: `createSession(userId, userAgent)` returns the raw token; `getSessionUser(token)`; cookie name and cookie options constants)
- `src/lib/auth/current-user.ts` (new, ~30 lines: `getCurrentUser()` reads the cookie via `next/headers` and returns the user or `null`)
- `src/lib/auth/login.test.ts` (new test)
- `src/lib/auth/session.test.ts` (new test)

## Definition of Done
- [ ] `authenticate` lowercases and trims the email, uses `verifyPassword`, and returns `null` for an unknown email and for a wrong password alike; for an unknown email it still verifies against a fixed dummy argon2id hash so timing does not reveal which emails exist
- [ ] Session token: 32 random bytes (base64url) from `crypto`; only its SHA-256 hash is stored; `getSessionUser` returns `null` for an unknown or malformed token and updates `lastUsedAt` at most once per hour
- [ ] Cookie options constant: `httpOnly`, `secure` in production, `sameSite: "lax"`, `path: "/"`, `maxAge` 400 days (the browser maximum); no server-side expiry (A-19)
- [ ] Tests (integration, test database): correct credentials return the user; wrong password and unknown email both return `null`; two logins for one user create two sessions that both resolve; the stored `tokenHash` differs from the raw token; an unknown token resolves to `null`
- [ ] Lint and tests green; independently mergeable (not wired to any route yet)

## Acceptance criteria covered
- #36 AC1 "Successful login" (credential check and session)
- #36 AC2 "Wrong credentials"
- #36 AC5 "I stay logged in" (long-lived per-device session)

## Notes
- The password rule is not checked at login (story note on FR-27).
- `current-user.ts` is server-only; never import it from client components.
